QuestInfo.name: [Happyville] Torr's Antlers
QuestInfo.0: I heard #p2002002# of Happyville has lost something very important...
QuestInfo.1: I heard #p2002002# of Happyville lost something very important, so I went to see him. I found him crying, and it turns out that... he lost his antlers?!? How can you lose your antlers?? He asked me to find his antlers but... where could they be?
QuestInfo.2: You found #b#t4031063##k and brought it to Torr. #p2002002# seemed very happy. Hopefully that was the last time he loses it...\n\n#bQuest available once a day.#k

0.0: Torr's looking at you. What would you say? \r\n#b#L0# Hey, where can I get the Christmas ornaments? #l\r\n#L1# Why are you crying?#l#k
0.1:
Grandpa Cliff scolded me again... and AGAIN... and AGAIN... because I lost my antlers AGAIN!.
#b#L0# You look great without your antlers#l
#L1# You should have paid attention before it happened.#l
#L2# Yeah... You should be more careful.#l#k
0.2: I lost my antlers while practicing for pulling Santa's sled. It's because I get nervous while flying, but people think I'm just clumsy.\r\n#b#L0# I will help you get your antlers back.#l\r\n#L1# What would you give to me if I get the antlers for you?#l#k
0.3: Really? Then can you look inside the shops around this place? Somebody mentioned... Hmm. Wah~ I forgot! Anyway, please look for my antlers. If you help me get my antlers back, I will give you something nice in return.

0.0: Argh, you should ask Rudi for that!! I need to look for my antlers!!!

1.0: ... Really? Thanks, but... I really need my antlers to help Grandpa Cliff ...
1.1: I know, I know, but when I zone-out on something, I totally forget about everything else...

2.1: Don't expect something in return when you are willing to help others!! There will be SOMEONE more than willing to help me out here, someone NICE.

yes.0: I can't go out because I don't have any antlers. I'm sure people will make fun of me for being clumsy. Since Grandpa Cliff and I visited the Cash Shop to buy Christmas gifts for our friends and family, I haven't seen my antlers anywhere. Perhaps you can take a look in there?

no.0: Hey, you said you were going to help... did you just lie to me??

1.0: Hey, those are my antlers! Thanks a lot! Here's a little something for a job well done. You'll need it. I'll see you around~

item.0: Did you find it? Oh yeah!! I remember which shop it is! It was called Cash Shop, and my antlers are displayed somewhere inside. Did you check to see if it was in there? Hmmm ... I have no idea where that shop is. Please check out the Cash Shop. Look into the place carefully, and you may find my antlers there.
